description: This file defines TypeScript types related to server node events, including the NodeEventContext interface with various dependencies and methods, and the NodeEvent type representing an event with optional payload.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Function to broadcast an event with a payload, with optional handling for slow receivers.

methods.name: nodeSendToSession
methods.description: Function to send an event to a specific session identified by sessionKey.

methods.name: nodeSubscribe
methods.description: Function to subscribe a node to a session.

methods.name: nodeUnsubscribe
methods.description: Function to unsubscribe a node from a session.

methods.name: addChatRun
methods.description: Function to add a chat run entry for a session.

methods.name: removeChatRun
methods.description: Function to remove a chat run entry for a session.

methods.name: refreshHealthSnapshot
methods.description: Function to refresh and retrieve the current health snapshot.

methods.name: loadGatewayModelCatalog
methods.description: Function to load the model catalog entries asynchronously.
